title: Startup Battlefield is returning to Australia — here’s what happened the last time we came to Sydney
summary: On August 19, Startup Battlefield is returning to Sydney in partnership with Stripe, one of the world's most iconic technology companies. We're taking over Stripe Tour Sydney for a night that the Australian startup ecosystem won't forget.

title: Helion, the Sam Altman-backed fusion startup, raises $465M to build a power plant for Microsoft
summary: Fusion startup Helion is racing to complete a power plant for Microsoft by 2028. A fresh infusion of cash should help with that.

title: Is Silicon Valley ready to put robots in people’s homes? Hello Robot is.
summary: The California startup released the fourth-generation of its home assistance robot, Stretch.

title: Quick-commerce FirstClub doubles valuation to $255M in 9 months
summary: The Bengaluru startup has crossed 1 million orders and reached a $50 million annualized GMV run rate within a year of launch.

title: Lovable signs multiyear deal with Google Cloud to up usage 5x, source says
summary: Lovable and Google signed an expanded multiyear deal that involves a 5x expansion of Lovable's footprint on Google Cloud, and expanded access to Anthropic Claude.

title: These two founders left Goldman and Meta to build voice AI for markets everyone else overlooked
summary: The startup's own stack for Africa and Middle East is now handling more than 17,000 calls per day.

title: Coralogix raises $200M on bet that someone needs to watch the AI agents
summary: Coralogix is among a growing number of infrastructure firms betting that as AI systems move into production, demand will rise for tools that can monitor their behavior, troubleshoot failures, and provide the operational data needed to keep them running reliably.

title: Cyera eyes $12B valuation at 80x ARR multiple despite operating losses
